biotools.summary: SEgene is a platform designed to identify links between super enhancers and gene expression across cell types. It utilizes the peak-to-gene links approach to facilitate the identification of super-enhancers functionally linked to transcriptional activity, providing analytical tools for evaluating super-enhancers as potential therapeutic targets.
